Faster, more reliable installation and updates through HACS.

- Each release now has a `quote_of_the_day.zip` with the integration, and HACS installs from that zip (`zip_release`). Before, HACS downloaded every file separately through the GitHub API, which could make an update hang.
- No other changes compared to v1.6.0; see the [v1.6.0 release notes](https://github.com/laurensdehoorne/HA-quote-of-the-day/releases/tag/v1.6.0) for what's new.
